bounded_candidate.decision: Only a bounded follow-up experiment is justified; the ceiling is below 0.3% whole-encode weight and no code change is recommended from this profile alone.
bounded_candidate.idea: Special-case only the 16x16 AVX2 sad4d slot as a direct monomorphic call to the existing inner leaf, bypassing the safe function-pointer wrapper ABI frame; retain the generic dispatch for every other shape.
bounded_candidate.observed_cost: The top-IP map assigns 86/2080 (4.1346%) to callee-saved push/pop and 24/2080 (1.1538%) to one stack argument reload in vpx_sad16x16x4d_avx2.
bounded_candidate.scope_guard: No equal-stride assumption, no union-bounds change, and no reference-plane bounds change. Source and reference strides remain independent.
bounded_candidate.whole_encode_ceiling: If all 110 direct rows were removed (an upper bound, not an expected gain), 110/2080 of the 5.074549% function-report share is 0.268366% of whole encoder sampled weight.

interpretation.address_calculation: lea/sub/shl derive row and candidate-reference offsets; no branches occur in the hot kernel body.
interpretation.arithmetic_reduction: vpaddd accumulates the four-lane SAD partial sums.
interpretation.branch_control: Only retq samples were observed; no conditional branch or call landed in the sampled kernel IPs.
interpretation.load: vmovdqu/vmovdqu64 and movq load source vectors or pointer arguments; rbp is a general pointer here, not a frame pointer.
interpretation.sad_arithmetic_with_load: vpsadbw performs byte absolute-difference accumulation while reading one reference vector from memory.
interpretation.shuffle_pack: vpunpck/vpblendd/vpermi2d repack the four lane totals.
interpretation.stack_argument_reload: movq loads caller arguments from the ABI stack home area; these are reloads, not spills.
interpretation.stack_frame_save_restore: push/pop preserves callee-saved registers; it is stack traffic but not a compiler spill.
interpretation.stack_spill: No sampled top-IP weight landed on a stack store/spill.
interpretation.stack_spill_or_reload: No sampled top-IP weight landed on stack spill/reload instructions.
interpretation.store: vmovdqu writes the four u32 results to the caller output.
